notes: §1985:VII.4.5.3 SR1 (amended): 'If identifier-1 is a function-identifier, it must reference an alphanumeric function. Record-name-1 and identifier-1 must not reference the same storage area.' SequentialIoBinder.BindRewrite hands the FROM operand to MoveBinder.BindFromPhrase, which asks StatementValidation.CheckPhraseOperandIsNotRecordArea (StorageSharing.IsRecordAreaOf, scoped by RecordAreaRule.InForce to Year < 2023; COBOL6827) and screens the function's category against FromPhraseRules.Rewrite (COBOL1914). The function sentence holds at 85: LENGTH is refused, UPPER-CASE runs, and the national/boolean widening of the row is unreachable because NATIONAL-OF and BOOLEAN-OF-INTEGER are COBOL1502 at 85. The storage sentence holds for a record of the file (the witness REWRITE F1-REC FROM F1-REC, and another 01 of the FD: COBOL6827) but not for an identifier that names the identical area by reference modification: REWRITE R1 FROM R1(1:10) on a 10-character record compiles and runs (IsRecordAreaOf returns false for any reference-modified operand, a choice docs/FILES_DESIGN.md D31(b) states; the rule's words still cover it). A part of the record (R1-B) is accepted, which the rule's 'the same storage area' permits. Probe classes: a (reference modification at the bounds 1:10; an OCCURS DEPENDING ON record), b (the record, an alternate 01, the whole-record ref-mod, part of the record, numeric functions), c (FROM literal COBOL0871, national and boolean functions COBOL1502), d (group, elementary, alphanumeric function), e (sequential file OPEN I-O after a seeding WRITE); f does not reach this syntax rule. kb/Work PB5412 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-read3/rd-02.json). || RE-VERDICTED CONFORMS (kb/Work PB5412, wave 20262025 group B): StorageSharing.IsRecordAreaOf decides 'the same storage area' on the storage the operand denotes (StorageExtent.OfReference), not on its form, so a literal reference modification of the whole record (R (1:10); R (1:) whatever R's length), the element of a table of one occurrence and a 66 THROUGH alias of the whole record are refused COBOL6827, and a SAME AREA peer's record is the area too (1985:VII.2.13.4 GR1, FileModel.StorageSharingFiles); docs/FILES_DESIGN.md D31(b) is revised. The read-3 and read-4 probes are all refused now. The function sentence's COBOL1914 message now cites the 1985 rule of the file's module (kb/Work PB5486: FromPhraseRules.FunctionRuleCite is an EditionCite).

next.reason: §1985:VII.4.5.3 SR1 as amended: 'If identifier-1 is a function-identifier, it must reference an alphanumeric function. Record-name-1 and identifier-1 must not reference the same storage area.' X3.23a-1989 added the function sentence; X3.23b-1993 restored the storage sentence to an unconditional one (the 1985 print: 'must not refer to the same storage area'). (a) Function: §2023:14.9.35.3 SR9 ('identifier-1 shall reference an alphanumeric, boolean, or national function'): the words 'or national' and 'boolean' widen what is accepted. (b) Storage: 2023 has no syntax rule refusing the overlap. §2023:14.9.35.4 GR7 makes REWRITE ... FROM a MOVE to the record followed by the REWRITE, and its NOTE 2 applies 14.6.10 and the MOVE rules 'to any cases in which the storage area identified by identifier-1 and the record area associated with file-name-1 share any part of their storage areas', the REWRITE being 'undefined if the result of execution of the implicit MOVE statement' is; §2023:14.6.10 GR1: 'the result of the statement is undefined' unless, §2023:14.6.10 GR2, the items share a data description entry ('the same as if the data items shared no part'); §2023:14.9.35.4 GR10 contemplates identifier-1 being 'one or part of one of the record descriptions'. A source 1985 refuses is accepted, with a defined or an undefined result and no exception condition.
